duration.description: Length of the audio in seconds.

cues.description: Every cue in the score, in seconds — including cues with no note on them.

beats.description: Every beat (quarter note) from 0 up to the end, in seconds.

track.description: Index of the track in the score.

pitch.description: Pitch, or the chord's pitches; absent for unpitched sounds.

chord.description: The chord symbol, when written as one.

strum.description: A strummed stroke: `t` is its first string.

end.description: For effects with a length (whoosh, riser, laser): when it ends, seconds.

cue.description: Set when the note is placed exactly on this cue.

notes.description: Every note and sound, repetitions expanded, sorted by time.

audibleUntil.description: When the audio falls below -40 dBFS for good (measured on the output).

lyrics.description: Lines of lyrics with every syllable's time, sorted by start, for a karaoke-style display. Present only when the score has lyrics.

track.description: Index of the track whose notes carry the line.

line.description: Index of the line within its track.

t.description: When the line's first syllable starts, seconds.

end.description: When the line's last syllable ends, seconds.

text.description: The syllable as displayed: no joining hyphen; a trailing space when a new word follows. A line's syllables joined give its `text`.

t.description: When the syllable's note starts, seconds.

end.description: When the syllable ends (its note's length, held over `_` notes, never past the next syllable), seconds.

description: When everything in a rendered jingle happens, in seconds rounded to 1 ms. Animation syncs to this.
